items.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan and I’ve very pleased to have bassist Buster Williams with me... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, you’ve been to the web site.

ctx.x: Buster was interviewed in New York City on January 6, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan and I’ve very pleased to have bassist Buster Williams with me for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. Thank you for coming today. It looks like your group “Something More” has a couple of busy months coming up.
Oh yeah, you’ve been to the web site.
